description: This file defines a NotificationsHandler class responsible for managing notification-related actions and states within an Android application. It includes interfaces and classes for handling notification snapshots, actions like open/dismiss/reply, and JSON serialization/deserialization for communication.

classes.name: NotificationsStateProvider
classes.description: An interface defining methods to read notification snapshot, request service rebind, and execute notification actions.

classes.name: SystemNotificationsStateProvider
classes.description: A singleton object implementing NotificationsStateProvider, providing system-level implementation for reading snapshots, rebind requests, and executing actions.

classes.name: NotificationsHandler
classes.description: Main class to handle notification listing and actions, processing JSON parameters, and communicating with the notification listener service.

methods.name: handleNotificationsList
methods.description: Handles request to retrieve the current notifications snapshot, returning it as a JSON string within a GatewaySession result.

methods.name: handleNotificationsActions
methods.description: Processes notification actions such as open, dismiss, reply based on JSON input, and returns the result.

methods.name: readSnapshotWithRebind
methods.description: Reads the current notification snapshot and requests a service rebind if the service is enabled but not connected.

methods.name: snapshotPayloadJson
methods.description: Converts a DeviceNotificationSnapshot object into its JSON string representation.

methods.name: parseParamsObject
methods.description: Parses JSON string parameters into a JsonObject, handling errors gracefully.

methods.name: readString
methods.description: Utility method to extract and trim string values from a JsonObject.
